title: 6.8 Schedules
unit_outcome: Ask where a familiar place is, understand simple directions, and use familiar transportation and schedule language.
goal: Understand simple whole-hour bus and train departure and arrival statements.
grammar_function: The bus/train leaves or arrives at + whole hour.
speaking_outcome: Say leaves/arrives schedule statements at familiar whole hours.
